_description: Gate-2-2 cross-run persistence schema. All fields are optional on load (backward compatibility).

memory_state._description: Echo / narrative memory that persists across runs (Gate 2-2).

echo_flags._description: Bit-field style container for echo-system persistence. All keys optional.

burden_noun_index.description: Index into the Burden Event collective_noun pool. Rotated deterministically per seed_room_topology. Persists across runs so the same noun does not repeat immediately.

burden_trigger_history.description: Cumulative count of Burden Event triggers across all runs. Used to ensure the 5-trigger-per-run numbness cap resets per run, while global analytics can be computed.

legacy_flags.description: Key-value flags for Legacy Archive triggers (e.g., 'legacy_once' = true).

narrative_unlocks.description: Key-value flags for narrative unlocks (Bios, Codex, Legacy Archive).

moral_flag_lifetime.description: Highest moral_flag ever reached across all runs (achievement / unlock gating).

tutorial_complete.description: Flag indicating if the player has completed the initial tutorial sequence.

run_state._description: Resumed during mid-run save (sleep / checkpoint), NOT persisted across runs.

burden_run_snapshot.trigger_count_this_run: int — 0 at run start, increments on each burden event trigger
burden_run_snapshot.last_noun_index_used: int — copied from memory_state.echo_flags.burden_noun_index at run start; may update during run
